A group of '''[[Mushroom/Legends|mushrooms]]''' existed on the [[Forest/Legends|forest]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. These [[Fungus/Legends|fungal]] creatures possessed a [[Color/Legends|brown]] stem topped by a dark-red cap with orange spots. The stem exhibited facial features, including two white [[Eye/Legends|eye]]s, a [[Nose/Legends|nose-like]] protrusion, and a [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]]. The creatures were capable of emoting; when startled, they emitted a yelping sound and withdrew into the base of their stem.<ref name="BFTS" />

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="date">{{EwoksDate|mushroom creatures|[[Battle for the Sunstar]]}}</ref> a field of these mycomorphic creatures had arisen near the position where [[Argazdan/Legends|Argazdan]] [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeologist]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Raygar]] had parked his [[Raygar's freighter|vessel]]. Raygar, who had arrived on the forested world in pursuit of the powerful [[Sunstar/Legends|Sunstar]] gem for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], had captured four of the [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] toward that end. The Ewoks, however, escaped their cell on Raygar's vessel with the assistance of Imperial [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[PD-28]] in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] affixed to the ship. Shortly after launching, the vessel jetted uncontrollably around the surrounding area and toward the mushrooms' cluster. The creatures, frightened by the wayward pod, retreated into their stems until it had cleared their cluster.<ref name="BFTS" />
